specs.Camera Lens: The DAC-203 features a 65°-100° wide-angle lens with 18x digital zoom and auto focus, designed for versatile framing and detailed photography.

features: 4K ULTRA HD VIDEO & 80MP PHOTOS: Capture high-resolution content with 4K video recording at 30FPS and photo resolution up to 80MP, with additional photo options including 64MP, 48MP, 36MP, 13MP and 8MP.
DUAL LCD SCREEN DESIGN: Features a 2.88-inch + 1.77-inch dual LCD screen setup, making it convenient to monitor your framing and shooting from different angles.
18X DIGITAL ZOOM & AUTO FOCUS: Equipped with 18X digital zoom and Auto Focus for convenient subject framing and detailed photography. The camera features a 65°-100° lens for versatile shooting.

BUILT-IN FILL LIGHT & DIGITAL IMAGE STABILIZATION: The DAC-203 includes a built-in fill light and digital image stabilization, helping you capture clearer and more stable photos and videos in different shooting conditions.

APP CONTROL & TYPE-C CONNECTIVITY: Supports Android and iPhone connectivity and app control through the Vipulse app. It features Type-C charging, a 700mAh battery, and supports Micro SD storage up to 128GB.
